svg.title: Memory versus compute time estimates
svg.desc: Calculated H100 time lower bounds. A 100-million-element FP32 vector add has 0.358 ms HBM time and a generous 0.00149 ms arithmetic bound using the published FP32 FMA peak; addition-only throughput is lower. An 8192-square FP16/BF16 matmul with FP32 output and ideal HBM input reuse has 0.160 ms memory time and 1.111 ms compute time. The larger estimate sets the model lower bound; real runtimes are not shown.
